name: window-switcher
title: Window Switcher
description: Find and switch to individual windows across apps and macOS Spaces
author: devadathanmb

commands.name: window-switcher
commands.title: Window Switcher
commands.description: Find and switch to individual windows across apps and macOS Spaces

preferences.name: showMinimizedWindows
preferences.title: Show Minimized Windows
preferences.description: Show minimized (hidden) windows in the list
preferences.label: Show Minimized Windows

preferences.name: showApplicationsWithoutVisibleWindows
preferences.title: Show Applications Without Visible Windows
preferences.description: Show windows belonging to applications hidden with macOS's Hide Application action
preferences.label: Show Applications Without Visible Windows

scripts.build:swift: cd win-ninja && swift build -c release && cp .build/release/win-ninja ../assets/win-ninja
scripts.build: npm run build:swift && ray build -o dist
scripts.fix-lint: eslint src --fix && prettier --write . && npm run format:swift
scripts.lint: eslint src && prettier --check . && swift format lint -r win-ninja/Sources/
